title: Napping Kansas driver whose truck sped on to soccer field and killed two won’t be charged
summary_full: Authorities declined to file charges against napping woman whose truck accelerated on to field during youth gameA soccer mom napping in her pickup truck when it suddenly accelerated on to the field at a Kansas youth tournament where her child was playing, killing two people, won’t face criminal charges, a prosecutor has said.Investigators believe the 34-year-old woman had failed to put the Chevrolet 1500 in park and likely put her foot on the gas pedal while sleeping at the Stryker Sports Complex in Wichita on 17 October. They conducted multiple interviews and even ran a test in the same parking spot with a similar vehicle. Continue reading...
